# WarTech Reforged 2.0.0 — combined weapons and headquarters

Experimental release for Minecraft 1.12.2 / Forge 14.23.5.2860 /
HBM NTM Community Edition 2.6.1.0 / MixinBooter 10.7. Java 8.
Changes since public CE 1.7.0, including the completed gun-artillery integration.

## Strategic launchers and silos

- Topol-M and Oreshnik: animated mobile launchers, dedicated missiles,
  cold ejection and engine ignition after clearing the canister. Topol carries
  one nuclear reentry vehicle; Oreshnik carries seven conventional vehicles,
  including a central impact.
- Iskander-M: two missiles, two independent targets, designator import,
  physical launch sequences and stronger impact effects.
- Complete underground silo: 17×17 site, 32-block depth, entrance, continuous
  ladder, five levels, galleries, lights and an animated HBM hatch.
  The construction kit pays for the structure; excavation produces no drops.
- Silo launch readiness with smoke, signals and flashing lights while waiting
  for a command. Launch opens the hatch and performs cold ejection.
- Zaslon-4 silo ABM: external radar, dedicated interceptor, hatch and cold
  launch. It targets hostile Topol-M/Oreshnik missiles and their reentry vehicles
  from mobile or silo launches. A physical intercept remains conditional.

## MLRS, gun artillery and additional missiles

- Grad, HIMARS, Uragan and Smerch: animated vehicles, actual launch tubes,
  dedicated rockets and warhead variants. Rockets stack to 16.
  HIMARS supports independent targets for its six tubes.
- D-30 and CAESAR: smooth aiming, recoil and barrel return, flash, smoke,
  sound and an actual projectile at the muzzle. All 12 Greg shell types,
  four 16-round slots and 500 HE per shot. D-30: 80–1200 blocks, 7-second
  reload. CAESAR: 120–2200 blocks, 5-second reload and a drivable chassis.
- Artillery designators bind to a launcher's UUID. One accepted command fires
  one round; repeated aiming/reload clicks do not duplicate expenditure.
- FP-5 Flamingo launches from the Geran platform; FP-7 uses the standalone
  ballistic launcher, not the Iskander vehicle; S8000 Banderol uses compatible
  aircraft/UAVs and the cruise-missile launcher.

## Air defense, radar and vehicles

- Buk-M3 (tier 2), Osa (tier 1) and 9S18 join the shared network with Tor,
  Pantsir, S-400, Patriot, command vehicles and relays.
- Animated S-400/Patriot models and matching missile exits. Both require an
  external radar.
- Smooth tracking, interception preparation and battery coordination.
  Fixed stale occupied channels, stalls after large raids and mixed
  S-400/Patriot ammunition handling.
- Ground-vehicle panels for driving, deployment and operation. Acceleration,
  coasting, braking/reverse, parking brake, hull checks, safe exits, HUD,
  camera and free look. First-person cabins are simplified.

## Headquarters, operations and reconnaissance

- A main computer combines owned defense sites and command vehicles in the
  dimension. Defense, attack and reconnaissance maps retain physical power,
  sensor and communication requirements.
- Named, saved and copied operations; a guided
  vehicle → loaded ammunition → target → timing workflow, XYZ and designators.
- Preparation/takeoff, returns, accepted/emitted/completed dependencies,
  intervals, deadlines, failure policies, fresh-intel/readiness/link conditions.
- Nine workspaces: overview, diagnostics, timing, areas, reconnaissance,
  supply, battle review, equipment and access. Named circular areas, groups,
  ammunition reserves and reports based on actual outcomes.
- Commander/operator/observer roles, edit-version conflicts, pause and recall
  of unissued orders. Uncertain launches are not automatically spent again.
- Intelligence comes from owned/team UAV observations and their history.
  Repeat observation refreshes data; allied IFF grants no foreign map access.

## Industry and multiplayer

- 54 industrial parts and 322 direct recipes: 289 assembly, four soldering,

# WarTech Reforged 2.0.0 — Combined Operations / Объединённое вооружение

**Experimental / Экспериментальный релиз.** Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge 14.23.5.2860,
HBM NTM **Community Edition 2.6.1.0**, MixinBooter 10.7, Java 8.
Use the same 2.0.0 on server and clients. Back up worlds before updating.

## Русский

Обновление после публичной 1.7.0 объединяет уже реализованные системы:

- Тополь-М/Орешник с холодным стартом, Искандер с двумя независимыми целями;
  готовая подземная шахта и ПРО «Заслон-4» по Тополю/Орешнику и их блокам.
- Град/HIMARS/Ураган/Смерч; Д-30 и CAESAR со снарядами Greg, баллистикой,
  плавным наведением/откатом и привязкой целеуказателя; FP-5/FP-7/S8000.
- Бук-М3, Оса, 9С18, анимированные С-400/Patriot, общая ПВО и вождение техники.
- Штаб: три карты, девять страниц, именованные операции, мастер атаки,
  зависимости, роли, разведка и отчётность по фактическим событиям.
- 54 промышленные детали и 322 прямых рецепта, реальные станки HBM и JEI,
  сохранность энергии, боезапаса, NBT и оплаченных конструкций.
- Серверные права, защита чужих карт/команд, большие сетевые планы,
  восстановление приказов и одиночного расхода после рестарта.

Конструкторы КР/БПЛА, авиация, Герань-2/5, РЭБ, ESM и HARM сохраняются.
Ярс отключён; автоматической доставки и полноценных детальных кабин нет.
Полное survival от руды, длительная MP-кампания, нагрузка всего модпака и
комплексная миграция пользовательского мира остаются непроверенными.

## English

Changes since public 1.7.0 combine implemented systems:

- Cold-launched Topol-M/Oreshnik, two-target Iskander, complete underground
  silos and Zaslon-4 ABM against Topol/Oreshnik missiles and reentry vehicles.
- Grad/HIMARS/Uragan/Smerch; D-30/CAESAR with Greg ammunition, ballistic flight,
  smooth aiming/recoil and designator binding; FP-5/FP-7/S8000.
- Buk-M3, Osa, 9S18, animated S-400/Patriot, shared defense and vehicle driving.
- Headquarters: three maps, nine workspaces, named operations, guided attacks,
  dependencies, roles, reconnaissance and reports based on actual events.
- 54 industrial parts, 322 direct recipes, native HBM machines and JEI,
  preservation of power, ammunition, NBT and paid construction materials.
- Server-side access, protected foreign maps/orders, large network plans
  and restart recovery without duplicate launch expenditure.

Cruise/UAV constructors, aviation, Geran-2/5, EW, ESM and HARM remain.
Yars is disabled; automatic supply delivery and full detailed cabins are absent.
Complete survival progression, long MP campaigns, full-modpack load and
comprehensive old-user-world migration remain unverified.

## Downloads / Файлы

- `WarTech-Reforged-1.12.2-NTM-CE-2.0.0.jar` — mod only; dependencies are external.
- `WarTech-Reforged-2.0.0-Docs-RU-EN.zip` — full manual, changes, recipes and credits.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — checksums / контрольные суммы.
- Separate RU/EN changelogs and Discord announcement files.

WarTech Reforged — Modular Warfare Update
For Minecraft 1.12.2 / HBM NTM Community Edition. Experimental branch.
This update centres on building your own cruise missile and integrating it
with reconnaissance, aircraft, UAVs and air defense. A successful strike now
depends on the weapon's configuration, flight program, carrier and opposing
defense—not just the ammunition you select.
Build your own cruise missiles
A new constructor with 44 parts, including four bodies, ten equipment
categories, reusable blueprints and starter configurations.
Four distinct classes: the light Lastvika jet-drone missile, versatile
Neptune, heavy low-observable Storm Shadow and a heavy long-range missile
using the Strizh model.
Engines, fuel, wings, navigation and payload determine actual mass, speed,
range and handling. A heavier warhead is a trade-off, not a free upgrade.
13 warheads: standard and heavy HE, thermobaric, penetrating, cluster
and fragmentation options, plus EMP, focused anti-vehicle and incendiary
payloads. Contact, delayed and airburst fuzes require compatible warheads.
Navigation, target search and coordinated attacks
Coordinate strikes and target search are separate modes. A conventional
program specifies one impact point; an active seeker can search several
designated areas for a suitable target.
Optical, thermal and radar seekers have different detection conditions,
target capabilities and countermeasure vulnerabilities.
Navigation quality affects local obstacle avoidance and accuracy. Advanced
systems diversify flight corridors and approach directions during group
attacks; basic configurations fly much more directly.
Suitable missiles with a command link can receive an updated mission in
flight. Better navigation does not remove fuel limits, search constraints
or the possibility of missing.
Ground launch and carrier integration
Ground launchers distinguish loading from launch authorization. Fire a
prepared missile using the launcher button or a linked detonator.
F-16C and Su-27 carry up to three light missiles, two Neptunes or one Storm
Shadow. Tu-95 accepts up to six compatible custom missiles, including the
heavy class.
Modular reconnaissance and strike UAVs can carry one suitable missile,
subject to rack type, mass, thrust and dimensional restrictions.
Carriers can obtain strike objectives from the programs stored in their
missiles and seek a valid release position. A target that is too close or
a visible obstacle calls for another approach, not a point-blank release.
Expanded UAV operations and Geran-5
The UAV constructor combines 28 parts, including three airframes, supporting
one-way attack craft, reusable scouts and weapon carriers.
Reconnaissance can be downloaded into a separate report item and read
later, independently of the drone's current flight.
Geran-5 is a new jet-powered round for the existing Geran catapult: faster,
harder to intercept and with twice Geran-2's warhead-strength parameter,
while retaining a comparable travel budget. Both autonomous launch and
manual piloting are supported.
A connected combat system
Range, power and carrier restrictions have been rebalanced. Weapon range,
mission radius, communication and detection are separate considerations.
Interception difficulty varies with the target's configuration. Air defense
respects team affiliation and coordinates follow-up attempts; a hit is
still not guaranteed.
Downed missiles can break up in the air or fall with consequences. Allied
strikes should not prematurely detonate nearby incoming friendly missiles
and UAVs; this does not disable all friendly fire.
Defense interfaces show equipment health, and damaged equipment can be
repaired using iron.
Long autonomous flights, remote launches and defense without a nearby
player use bounded server-side chunk loading rather than keeping an
entire route permanently active.
Refreshed interfaces, localization, icons, Creative-tab organization,

# WarTech Reforged Changelog

## 1.6.0 - 2026-07-30

WarTech Reforged 1.6.0 contains two separate builds:

- **Stable:** Minecraft `1.7.10`, Forge `10.13.4.1614`, HBM NTM
  `1.0.27 X5751` or HBM NTM Space `X5758 H261`.
- **Experimental port:** Minecraft `1.12.2`, Forge `14.23.5.2860`,
  NTM Extended `3.0.3`.

The builds are not interchangeable. Never install both JARs in the same
`mods` directory.

### Added

- Complete Minecraft 1.12.2 compatibility port of the WarTech Reforged 1.6
  content catalog, mechanics, registries, recipes, entities, tile entities,
  GUIs, networking, save data, models, textures and sounds.
- Driveable command, radar, electronic-warfare, air-defense and artillery
  vehicles with deployment states, persistent inventories, HBM energy and IFF.
- Patriot, S-400, Tor-M1 and Pantsir-S2 air-defense systems with layered radar
  tracking, target reservation and tiered interceptor behavior.
- Strategic early-warning radar, long-range communication relays, air-raid
  siren integration and faction command networking.
- Geran-2, MQ-9 Reaper, F-16C, Su-27, Tu-95, Kh-555, aircraft payloads,
  countermeasures, wrecks and Remote Pilot controls.
- HBM-compatible artillery target designator and restored Greg/Henry FIFO
  target queues.
- Legacy NBT migration for vehicles, aircraft, missiles, launchers, radars,
  EW equipment, artillery, ownership and inventories.
- Automated registry, resource, NBT, vehicle-input, missile-impact and archive
  integrity tests for the 1.12.2 port.

### Changed

- Ground vehicles retain the original maximum speeds and heavy-vehicle
  handling from the 1.7.10 implementation.
- Aircraft and drone remote controls use synchronized mouse flight, smoothed
  telemetry and nose/chase camera modes.
- Cruise, ballistic, anti-radiation and air-launched weapons use swept impact
  checks so fast missiles cannot skip through their target.
- Pantsir-S2 uses Tier-1 interceptors; Tor-M1 uses Tier-2 interceptors, matching
  the original behavior.
- Item previews use the original model transforms and textures without leaking
  the Minecraft item atlas into OBJ rendering.

### Fixed

- Restored functional movement for all ground vehicles, including remapped
  controls, server-authoritative input and correct client synchronization.
- Restored the original per-machine GUI layouts, slots, controls and status
  synchronization instead of a shared replacement interface.
- Restored original models, binary textures, item previews, GUI resources,
  animation, missile orientation and loaded-payload rendering.
- Restored cruise and ballistic launcher activation by hand, redstone,
  detonator and remote strike caller.
- Fixed Geran-2 catapult clearing, automatic and manual launch paths, remote
  collision fuse and operator self-damage.
- Fixed MQ-9 and aircraft target queues, weapon release, hardpoint rendering,
  flight, camera clipping and weapon-action jitter.
- Fixed Iskander trajectory, impact detection, warhead detonation and launch
  exhaust.
- Fixed Kh-555 stowed and in-flight orientation, route continuity and impact.
- Restored original missile, bomb, artillery and interceptor damage mappings,
  terrain destruction, fire, smoke, mushroom effects and sounds.
- Restored complete interceptor success, failure, malfunction and ground-impact
  effects.
- Restored Greg/Henry animation, target memory, sequential fire and projectile
  effects.
- Restored communication mast multiblock deployment, strategic radar structure
  and animated radar assemblies.
- Fixed NTM Extended compatibility crashes, dedicated-server class separation
  and Java 8 packaging.

### 1.12.2 Experimental Warning

The Minecraft 1.12.2 build is an **experimental compatibility port**. Automated
checks pass, but they cannot reproduce every modpack, client renderer,
dedicated server, multiplayer timing condition or migrated world.

Crashes and behavioral differences may still exist, including rendering,
